Opened by British artist Stanley William Hayter in 1927, Atelier 17 specialized in intaglio techniques—especially etching and engraving, both of which involved incising a printing plate—using these traditional processes as a starting point from which to develop new and revolutionary methods. Beyond printmaking techniques, Atelier 17 was also instrumental in the development of Surrealism, an influential art movement that began in Paris during the early 1920s and examined dreams and the unconscious. Important Surrealists, such as Max Ernst and André Masson, explored these new ideas through printmaking at Atelier 17’s Paris location. When the studio relocated to New York in 1940, at the onset of World War II, its artists did the same and brought their innovative style with them. Good quality data is essential to better prepare for and respond to pre-existing and emerging threats to both livestock and people. This includes information on disease distribution, and understanding of risk factors for spread in animals and/or spill over to human populations. Only through an accurate disease picture can decision-makers implement evidence-based targeted prevention and control programmes that mitigate the impact of animal diseases. pages.text: Survey and Census History Survey and Census History Skip Navigation Within Survey and Census History Survey and Census History As the United States grew, the nation's interests became more complex. People and policy planners needed a more detailed idea of the economic and demographic characteristics of America so that they could make decisions and plan for the future. Because of this, the census expanded over time from a simple headcount in 1790 (which only classified Americans by age, sex, and race), to over 200 different surveys today. U.S. Census Bureau programs can be split into two broad categories: demographic and economic. The number of inquiries under each of these categories has expanded over time, gaining accuracy even as they also grow increasingly detailed. November 20, 1967 - President Lyndon B. Johnson announces that the census population clock reached the 200 million mark. In 1810, the census was expanded to obtain, for the first time, information on manufacturing and manufactured products. After a hiatus in 1830, the economic portion of the census returned in 1840, with added questions on agriculture, mining, and fisheries. The 1850 census also was the first demographic census to collect social data, including questions on taxation, churches, pauperism and crime. The amount of information collected would only increase in the following decades. With the creation of a permanent Census Bureau in 1902, there was an opportunity to expand the survey-taking role of the Census Bureau beyond the decennial demographic and economic censuses. pages.text: Suspend Execution For A Short Time Small. Fast. Reliable. Choose any three. Home Menu About Documentation Download License Support Purchase Search About Documentation Download Support Purchase Search Documentation Search Changelog SQLite C Interface Suspend Execution For A Short Time int sqlite3_sleep(int); The sqlite3_sleep() function causes the current thread to suspend execution for at least a number of milliseconds specified in its parameter. If the operating system does not support sleep requests with millisecond time resolution, then the time will be rounded up to the nearest second. The number of milliseconds of sleep actually requested from the operating system is returned. SQLite implements this interface by calling the xSleep() method of the default sqlite3_vfs object. If the xSleep() method of the default VFS is not implemented correctly, or not implemented at all, then the behavior of sqlite3_sleep() may deviate from the description in the previous paragraphs. If a negative argument is passed to sqlite3_sleep() the results vary by VFS and operating system. Some system treat a negative argument as an instruction to sleep forever. Others understand it to mean do not sleep at all. In SQLite version 3.42.0 and later, a negative argument passed into sqlite3_sleep() is changed to zero before it is relayed down into the xSleep method of the VFS. The Susquehanna River facilitated transportation and trade for indigenous people and later settlers. Serving as the temporary seat of the Continental Congress during the Revolutionary War, the town of York saw the approval of the Articles of Confederation. From our places and purposes to our partnerships and people, sustainability has fast become embedded in the life of the Library. A lot of this work is visible from the outside, from the solar panels on our roof in St Pancras to the environmental themes in our exhibitions and the great work we’re all celebrating right now during Green Libraries Week . But there’s plenty goes on behind the scenes too, particularly in terms of our collection. Not just in terms of what we collect, but also in terms of how we manage and care for it, for generations to come. As a knowledge institution, our collection is at the heart of what we do. They can generate substantial amounts of waste and contribute to a carbon footprint, both through on site activities and through participant travel and accommodation. Making meetings and events more sustainable is therefore essential —not only to reduce environmental impact, but also to clearly demonstrate organizational values and commitments. A range of practical measures can be applied to significantly reduce the environmental footprint of in person events and support the delivery of climate neutral outcomes. The following measures can be applied to make events more sustainable: Reducing waste generated by meetings and conferences , particularly from printed materials and single use plastic water bottles; Improving energy efficiency through measures such as optimized lighting and smart control systems in meeting spaces; Using sustainable materials for furniture and fittings, including bamboo and other eco friendly alternatives; Promoting paper smart and plastic free conferences; Offering sustainable food and beverage options during coffee breaks and receptions; Raising awareness among participants and visitors to encourage active engagement in sustainability efforts; Offsetting carbon emissions associated with event organization and participation. pages.text: Sustainable procurement | Corporate Environmental Responsibility | FAO Share Close Corporate Environmental Responsibility Sustainable procurement As an international organization with a global mandate, FAO has a strong responsibility to deliver its activities in an environmentally responsible and sustainable way . Sustainable procurement plays a key role in achieving this goal. For FAO, sustainable procurement goes beyond obtaining the best value for money. It is a strategic lever for generating positive benefits for society and the economy as a whole. This approach often requires additional time, resources, and close collaboration across the supply chain, as it looks at the wider environmental and social impacts of procurement decisions. FAO’s procurement function actively supports the Organization’s Corporate Environmental Responsibility Policy. This includes promoting best practices that reduce FAO’s environmental footprint while improving operational efficiency . Wherever feasible and in the best interest of the Organization and its stakeholders, environmental criteria are integrated into procurement processes, ensuring sustainability is a standard consideration rather than an afterthought. A good example for sustainable procurement practices is the IT hardware Long Term Agreement where the supplier committed to managing all activities in line with FAO’s Corporate Environmental Responsibility Policy , including collection of obsolete IT equipment, its consequent recycling, upgrading and reuse or disposal, ensuring a more sustainable approach throughout service delivery.

SVG ist damit ein textbasierter, offener Webstandard zur Beschreibung von Bildern, die sich bei jeder Größe scharf darstellen lassen. SVG wurde speziell für die Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Webstandards entwickelt, darunter CSS , DOM , JavaScript und SMIL . Im Wesentlichen ist SVG für Grafiken das, was HTML für Text ist. SVG-Bilder und ihr zugehöriges Verhalten werden in XML -Textdateien definiert. Dadurch lassen sie sich durchsuchen, indexieren, mit Skripten bearbeiten und komprimieren. Außerdem können sie mit jedem Texteditor oder mit Zeichenprogrammen erstellt und bearbeitet werden. Im Gegensatz zu klassischen Bitmap-Bildformaten wie JPEG oder PNG lassen sich Vektorgrafiken im SVG-Format ohne Qualitätsverlust in jeder Größe darstellen. Sie können außerdem einfach lokalisiert werden, indem der enthaltene Text geändert wird – ein Grafikeditor ist dafür nicht erforderlich. Mit geeigneten Bibliotheken lassen sich SVG-Dateien sogar dynamisch lokalisieren. SVG wird seit 1999 vom World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) entwickelt. Each year, these hawks travel thousands of miles between their breeding grounds in the western United States and Canada and their wintering sites in Central and South America. California’s Central Valley is especially critical to their life cycle, with 95 percent of the state’s Swainson’s Hawks nesting there. Upon arrival in the Central Valley, Swainson’s Hawks select nest sites near grasslands or agricultural fields, which offer abundant prey and shelter. During the breeding season, their diet consists mainly of rodents, rabbits, reptiles, and small birds, which are essential for raising their young. Outside the breeding season, they adapt by feeding primarily on insects such as grasshoppers, demonstrating remarkable versatility. Overview The "swarmvtab" virtual table allows the user to query a large number of tables (hereafter "component" tables) with similar schemas but distinct ranges of rowid values as if they were a single database table. The tables may be (and usually are) located in different databases. Swarmvtab tables are read-only. Component tables must not be declared WITHOUT ROWID, and must all have the same schema, but may have different names within their databases. In this context, "the same schema" means that: All component tables must have the same set of columns, in the same order. The types and default collation sequences attached to each column must be the same for all component tables. All component tables must have the same PRIMARY KEY declaration (if any). A swarmvtab table has the same schema as each of its component tables. A swarmvtab virtual table is created as follows: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE temp.<name> USING swarmvtab(<sql-statement>); Swarmvtab virtual tables must be created in the temp schema. pages.text: Switch-hitters getting noticed at MLB Breakthrough Series Skip to Content VERO BEACH, Fla. -- Most hitters spend years trying to perfect one swing. Deniel Gonzalez and Chris Woodson Jr. are working on two. Learning two swings requires years of repetition and countless patience. But the ability to hit from both sides of the plate can create advantages against pitchers, help in key situations and provide scouts with another reason to take notice. Those benefits are what drew both players to switch-hitting, a unique skill they brought to the Breakthrough Series at the Jackie Robinson Training Complex in Vero Beach. “The advantage is that I can get noticed more, in a way,” Gonzalez said. “Because obviously, not too many people hit on both sides, and it's just easier for at-bats in a game. … I thought this is a great [opportunity] to get your name out there.” One advantage comes when a left-handed hitter faces a right-handed pitcher and sees a release point farther away, giving him a fraction of a second longer to track the ball. It can also help in situational baseball, making it easier to move runners. Gonzalez started switch-hitting when he found out his dad, who played college ball at Queens College and Monroe College, was a switch-hitter. Symptoms and Care of RSV Feb. 20, 2026 What to know Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) usually causes mild, cold-like symptoms. Most RSV infections go away on their own. RSV can be serious for babies, some young children, and adults who are older or have certain risk factors. Most RSV symptoms can be managed with over-the-counter medications. Overview People infected with RSV usually show symptoms within 4 to 6 days after getting infected. Symptoms of RSV infection usually include: Runny nose Congestion Decrease in appetite Coughing Sneezing Fever Wheezing These symptoms usually appear in stages and not all at once. In very young infants with RSV, their only symptoms may be irritability, decreased activity, and breathing difficulties. RSV can worsen underlying lung conditions like chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) or asthma. People with RSV infection and COPD or asthma may need treatment for asthma attacks or COPD flare-ups. Symptoms of Hepatitis A For Everyone Oct. 27, 2026 Key points Most people who get hepatitis A have a mild, short-term illness. You can still spread hepatitis A virus (HAV) even if you don't have symptoms. Adults are more likely than children to have symptoms. Instead, simply import sys and then use sys.monitoring . This namespace provides access to the functions and constants necessary to activate and control event monitoring. As programs execute, events occur that might be of interest to tools that monitor execution. The sys.monitoring namespace provides means to receive callbacks when events of interest occur. Tool identifiers are used to discourage tools from interfering with each other and to allow multiple tools to operate at the same time. Currently tools are completely independent and cannot be used to monitor each other. This restriction may be lifted in the future. Before registering or activating events, a tool should choose an identifier. Identifiers are integers in the range 0 to 5 inclusive. Close sz17900's Diary BetterIME - JOSM 中文输入法优化插件 Posted by sz17900 on 5 April 2026 in Chinese (China) (‪中文(中国大陆)‬) . [English] BetterIME is a JOSM plugin that automatically manages Chinese IME state based on focus context, preventing IME from intercepting keyboard shortcuts while editing the map. GitHub: https://github.com/nj-yzf/josm-BetterIME 问题背景 使用中文输入法编辑 OpenStreetMap 时，JOSM 的快捷键（如 S 选择、A 添加节点、W 提高路径精度等）经常被输入法拦截，导致快捷键失效。每次都要手动切换输入法，非常影响编辑效率。 为此我开发了 BetterIME 插件，让 JOSM 根据当前操作场景自动控制输入法状态。 功能介绍 插件将输入法控制分为三种场景： 自动切换至中文输入法： - 编辑 name、name:zh、name:zh-Hans、name:zh-Hant、alt_name、operator 标签时 - 打开 F3「搜索预设组合」对话框时 默认英文，可手动切换： - 其他文本输入框（如 Ctrl+F 查找、其他标签编辑等） 禁用输入法（快捷键正常工作）： - 地图视图、工具栏等非文本组件，Shift/Ctrl+Space 也无法意外切换至中文 此外，插件还释放了 Ctrl+Space 快捷键（JOSM 默认绑定为「搜索菜单项」），让它回归系统输入法切换功能。 首选项设置 通过 编辑 → 首选项 (F12) 打开 BetterIME 设置页，可以： 启用/禁用自动输入法切换（总开关） 启用/禁用 F3 搜索预设对话框中的中文输入法 启用/禁用基于标签键的自动检测 自定义触发中文输入法的标签键列表（支持添加、删除、重置） 所有设置即时生效，无需重启 JOSM。 安装方式 方式一：JOSM 内置插件管理器 1. 打开 编辑 → 首选项 → 插件 2. 搜索 BetterIME 3. 勾选启用，重启 JOSM 方式二：手动安装 1. 从 GitHub Releases 页面下载 BetterIME.jar： https://github.com/nj-yzf/josm-BetterIME/releases 2. 将 JAR 文件复制到 JOSM 插件目录（Windows: %APPDATA%\JOSM\plugins\） 3. 在 编辑 → 首选项 → 插件 中勾选启用，重启 JOSM 兼容性 JOSM 19555 及以上版本 Java 11 及以上 目前仅在 Windows 上测试过，macOS 和 Linux 上的输入法框架不同，可能无法正常工作，欢迎反馈测试结果 反馈 如果遇到问题或有功能建议，欢迎在 GitHub 提交 Issue： https://github.com/nj-yzf/josm-BetterIME/issues 许可证：GPL-2.0-or-later（与 JOSM 一致） Discussion Leave a comment Log in to leave a comment

pages.text: Sólo queremos verdad y justicia - Amnistía Internacional Sólo queremos verdad y justicia - Amnistía Internacional ¿En qué idioma desea utilizar este sitio? English Español Français Cerrar Sus seres queridos se desvanecieron en manos del Estado, y dejaron a las familias sumidas en un dolor interminable. Durante más de tres decenios, las Madres/Personas del Sábado se han concentrado en Estambul para exigir verdad, justicia y rendición de cuentas. Envía un mensaje instando al ministro del Interior, Ali Yerlikaya, a reabrir la plaza Galatasaray para que sus vigilias pacíficas puedan continuar sin restricciones indebidas. ¿Cuál es el problema? Las Madres/Personas del Sábado llevan más de 30 años concentrándose en Estambul para recordar a sus seres queridos y exigir verdad y justicia por sus desapariciones forzadas, ocurridas a manos de las autoridades de Turquía durante las décadas de 1980 y 1990. No pueden llorarlos ni pasar página: no hay tumbas que visitar, ni respuestas, ni rendición de cuentas. En lugar de eso, llevan fotos de sus seres queridos víctimas de desaparición forzada, y celebran vigilias pacíficas semanales en la plaza Galatasaray, en el centro de Estambul . Desde 2018, las personas que participan en estas vigilias totalmente pacíficas han sufrido represión policial, incluidos malos tratos, detención y juicios penales. La plaza Galatasaray se ha rodeado de barreras de metal con presencia policial ininterrumpida. pages.text: T. rex had lips, upending its enduring pop culture image | National Geographic Premium SCIENCE ​ T. rex had lips, upending its enduring pop culture image Whether carnivorous dinosaurs had lips has long been the stuff of paleo-debate. A new study finds evidence that flesh covered the predators’ teeth. Tyrannosaurus rex and other carnivorous dinosaurs likely had soft tissue that covered their sharp teeth, as seen in this illustration. Lips would have kept their teeth moist and protected—and ready to attack prey. Illustration by Mark P. Witton By Riley Black Published March 30, 2023 • 6 min read The fearsome jaws of Tyrannosaurus are famous. In museum halls, paleo art, and even feature films such as Jurassic Park , the Cretaceous carnivore has traditionally been depicted with banana-size fangs and a sinister grin. But paleontologists have now discovered that the living animal did not have a sharp-toothed smirk— T. rex , as well as many other carnivorous dinosaurs, had lips. Reported today in Science , a multi-institution team of paleontologists propose that carnivorous dinosaurs like T. rex and Allosaurus had fleshy lips covering their teeth, much as modern-day lizards do. The hypothesis will likely alter both the public image of dinosaurs as well as how paleontologists study the ways these terrible lizards fed. pages.description: The formidable Tyrannosaurus rex had nothing to fear—except possibly its own kind, gnawed fossil bones suggest.
pages.text: T. Rex Was a Cannibal, Bone Gashes Suggest | National Geographic Tooth gouges on this 65-million-year-old T. rex toe bone could have been made only by another T. rex. Diagram courtesy Nicholas Longrich, Yale University T. Rex Was a Cannibal, Bone Gashes Suggest Mighty predators may have attacked kin or scavenged corpses. By Brian Handwerk Published October 15, 2010 • 3 min read The formidable Tyrannosaurus rex likely had nothing to fear—except possibly its own kind, a new study suggests. Paleontologist Nick Longrich of Yale University was examining dinosaur bones found in Montana when he noticed large gouges in bones that had yet to be indentifiied. The gouges had to have been made by a large carnivore, he said, and when the mystery fossils were deposited 65 million years ago, T. rex was the only North American carnivore large and toothy enough to make such marks. But the seemingly routine find took a macabre turn when Longrich discovered one of the bitten bones belonged to a T. rex —making it apparent evidence of cannibalism. This toe bone "has giant theropod bite marks, and the only one there [at that time] was T. rex ," he said. "There was really no other conclusion I could come to." (Related: "Tiny T. rex Ancestors Achieved World Domination." ) Further analysis in several fossil collections turned up three more similarly bitten T. rex bones. Longrich and colleagues speculate the giant predators may have engaged in cannibalism with some regularity—but it's unknown whether the dinosaurs fought to the death or simply scavenged T. rex corpses. pages.text: Tackling antimicrobial resistance through One Health: protecting people, animals and the environment Share Close One Health Tackling antimicrobial resistance through One Health: protecting people, animals and the environment Antimicrobial resistance is one of the world's most pressing health challenges. Addressing it requires coordinated action across human health, animal health, agriculture and the environment. Antimicrobials, including antibiotics, are essential medicines used to prevent and treat infections in people, animals and plants. They help protect health, support food production and safeguard livelihoods. But their effectiveness is increasingly threatened by antimicrobial resistance (AMR). AMR occurs when microorganisms, such as bacteria, viruses, fungi and parasites, no longer respond to medicines designed to treat them. While resistance occurs naturally, the misuse and overuse of antimicrobials accelerate its emergence and spread. Resistant microorganisms can circulate among people, animals, food and the environment, making AMR a challenge that no single sector can address alone. This is why a One Health approach is essential. How are human, animal and ecosystem health connected? The health of people, animals, plants and ecosystems is closely interconnected, creating pathways through which antimicrobial-resistant microorganisms and resistance genes can spread. In livestock production, for example, antibiotics are sometimes needed to treat bacterial infections. However, inappropriate use can contribute to resistance. She explains why systematic manipulation is like the Hydra: cut off one head and two more grow back. Paper mills are evolving, and so must our response. From fabricated research papers to manipulated citations, fraudulent peer reviews, and authorship-for-sale schemes, systematic manipulation is becoming increasingly sophisticated. For editors, publishers, and research integrity professionals, recognizing the warning signs early and knowing how to respond have never been more important. On 5 November, I led a session as part of COPE's Publication Integrity Week 2026, exploring practical ways to identify and respond to organized manipulation of the publication process. pages.text: Tag team: dual waterspouts appear in San Francisco Bay amid stormy weather | California | The Guardian Skip to main content Skip to navigation Two waterspouts formed over the San Francisco Bay this past weekend, a rare weather occurrence California Tag team: dual waterspouts appear in San Francisco Bay amid stormy weather Phenomenon is not a common occurrence in the Bay area and inclement weather is expected to continue for few days Uwa Ede-Osifo Tue 17 Nov 2026 21.33 EST First published on Tue 17 Nov 2026 20.50 EST Share Prefer the Guardian on Google A pair of waterspouts were recorded recently in the San Francisco Bay area, much to the delight and shock of several observers, as storms pummelled the region. Two waterspouts – vortexes of air and water mist, essentially tornadoes – cut a sheer streak into the sky, as they spiraled above the bay, according to social media footage capturing the weather phenomenon. While prevalent in the Great Lakes and the south-east Florida coast, waterspout sightings are not common for the Bay area, according to federal storm data. The National Weather Service (NWS) confirmed the waterspout occurrence in a special marine warning on Monday. Some waterspouts, dubbed “fair weather”, are weak, while others, typically tornadic waterspouts, can pose a risk to boaters and coastal areas if they travel on shore. pages.text: Tagging and Transcription for Chinese Heritage Records | National Archives Top Skip to main content Tagging and Transcription for Chinese Heritage Records From 1882 to 1943 the United States Government severely curtailed immigration from China to the United States, passing a series of laws whose result was the documentation of international movements of many Chinese nationals. Certain Federal agencies were particularly active in enforcing the exclusion laws, including the Customs Service, the Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS), which in 2003, became the United States Citizenship and Immigration Service (USCIS), and the U.S. District Courts. Many of the records created to implement the Chinese exclusion laws are now in the custody of the National Archives and have been digitized. The records are a major resource for the study of Chinese immigration and Chinese-American travel, trade, and social history from the late-19th to mid-20th century. Because many documents relate to individual immigrants, they are invaluable for the study of Chinese and Chinese-American family history. For more information about these records, please visit us online at https://www.archives.gov/research/chinese-americans Please help us tag, comment, and transcribe these records for greater access. Gather teams or individual players and a host who will run the game. The host is logged into the Catalog, and pulls up the list of records for the game. The host presents an image, the teams have one minute to write their keywords. Traveling between cities and trailheads takes just a couple of hours; at most, half a day. Yushan National Park Mount Yushan , also known as Mount Jade, is not only the tallest peak in Taiwan, but also the tallest peak in Northeast Asia. La Plagne is one of the most eco-conscious and family-friendly ski resorts in France. Office de Tourisme de La Plagne Vallée By Isabel Conway Published September 12, 2026 This article was produced by National Geographic Traveller (UK). A Paris railway station on a miserable, rainy January night feels worlds away from sunny alpine slopes and high-altitude soft powder. But vintage train carriages emblazoned with ‘Les Arcs’, ‘La Plagne’, ‘Tignes’, ‘Meribel’ and ‘Val d’Isere’ get my adrenaline flowing. At the belle époque-style Gare de Lyon, Guillaume de Marcillac, co-founder and CEO of Pegasus Trains, is greeting passengers about to board the sleeper train. He explains that by repurposing “elderly” train stock, his company offers travellers “a credible, low-impact alternative to flying or driving to their winter sport destination”. The train, chartered by UK tour operator Travelski for the 2025-26 winter season, is the first sleeper service to the Alps in nine years — and there are plans for it to run for winters to come. In our no-frills, six-person couchette for the nine-hour journey, I’ll admit I struggled to get comfortable on my hard lower berth. I’m awoken by occasional loud rattling and crunching brakes in the dead of night, but it feels a small price to pay for a more responsible way to travel.
